Name: (CP) RitzyGen's Halloween Pumpkin Bobbers
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
[s][size=1]Here I am, making new mods instead of working on pre-made ones...[/size][/s][size=2]
Hey Everyone! I have made Halloween-ish bobbers for fishing with![/size][size=3]
They Replace the Red, Blue, Green, And Yellow bobbers, so make sure you have them selected with the fishing bobber machine thingy in Willy's shop, if you want them to show up on your fishing rod. you can change which color bobber(s) you want to be replaced in the config menu.
I might make some more spooky bobbers, If you guys have any suggestions.


[/size][size=4]REQUIREMENTS:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url].


INSTALLING INSTRUCTIONS:
[/size][size=3]Move the .zip files into your Stardew Valley/Mods Folder, And Extract the files.


[/size][size=2]
Please do not upload these files as your own mod.
Or post to any other mod sites.
Or post on sites behind a paywall/sell otherwise.[/size][size=3]


NOTES:
[/size][size=2]The reason I did not simplify the patches, is because I cannot do the proper math required to figure out the dimensions for the X and Y. I apologize, but until I am smarter, or someone helps me with this, I cannot change it.[/size][size=3]
[/size]you may recolor the bobbers if you wish, please just do the .png replace method, and do not use my content.json/.png files. thank you.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18499]
[/url]
